QUOTE: `batchRecords` is the common write point for every `BaseDataOperator` subclass. That includes ... the agents, playbooks, and boards handlers... Each handler is a factory of the form `const XHandler = <TBase extends Constructor<ServerDataOperatorBase>>(superclass) => class extends superclass {...}`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says each mixin is constrained to extend ServerDataOperatorBase and that writes go through the inherited batchRecords, although it also notes two exceptions that bypass it.
